svg.title: The left-hand side is an actual fixed-placement hierarchy limit of its lattice two-point moment. The two lattice positions are the prescribed near point and the origin. They are distinct and have a common nonwrapping placement on the eventual volume tail. The spectator is its retained corrected lift, so the coefficient and correlation limits use the same refinement. The coordinate identity in (TS2) converts the first insertion of bβ p kisi(vki) under the scaling frame into bβ p kib5 i a5 i project(Xki −βkiZki),
